mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that increases the probability of a central bank rate cut, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.5, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 6.5 is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and a rise in real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in housing demand and a shift in consumer behavior toward saving, which together signal an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST declines and RSAFS rises, or the interaction term in a regression model has a coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-driven economic slowdown (indicated by a 3-month decline in industrial production), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing sector weakness signals reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC for INDPRO decline is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month average indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS > 0.5 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a stagflationary environment where inflation is rising but policy is easing, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced real returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or the interaction term in a regression model has a coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion (indicated by rising residential construction permits and real consumer spending), the S&P 500 tends to outperform as housing and consumption growth drive corporate earnings, leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST and RSAFS both rise, or the interaction term in a regression model has a coefficient with p-value > 0.05.
